rationale: Several papers contribute substantive new evidence on the causes of the Hubble constant discrepancy, such as local inhomogeneities, a decreasing trend in $H_0$, and the impact of a local void. However, the question remains open as no single resolution is universally accepted. Papers 2202.11852, 2212.00238, 2501.08915, 2502.02864, 2412.12245, and 2310.03509 all provide insights into different aspects of the tension.
